notes.subject: יחיל…יחיל
notes.rationale: Verb doubled exactly as Hebrew doubles it: voice shakes, then Yahwe shakes — parallel repetition preserved.

notes.subject: guriaim
notes.rationale: חוּל is 'twist/whirl/writhe' — earthquake verb; Tok Pisin 'guriaim' (shake) keeps the physical picture, though the twisting sense narrows.

notes.subject: graun wailples
notes.rationale: מִדְבָּר is open pasture-land that became wilderness; 'graun wailples' could also be 'ol gaden wail graun' if the pasture sense is foregrounded.

translation: Voes bilong Yahwe i guriaim graun wailples; Yahwe i guriaim graun wailples bilong Kades.
